answer.reason: Both are global asset managers whose clients are institutions and financial advisors. Cohen & Steers runs its own funds and strategies, specializing in real assets and alternative income. AMG is a partner and investor in independent boutique firms, and it provides them with strategic and distribution support. AMG's own offering is partly equity partnerships with those firms, and its investment strategies are diversified, not focused on real assets. The overlap is on customers and general investment management. The business model and specialization differ, so this is adjacent.

T:P2.2.text: Cohen & Steers is a focused investment-led asset manager, specializing in real assets and alternative income.

T:P2.3.text: We are focused investment-led experts, specializing in real assets and alternative income

T:P2.4.text: Dedicated to the pursuit of excellence in everything we do.

T:P2.5.text: Our teams are relentless in their drive to provide superior investment solutions and passionate about constantly innovating to meet the needs of clients today and anticipate their challenges of tomorrow.

T:P2.6.text: Years avg. experience of senior investment professionals

T:P2.7.text: We work together every day to help our clients achieve the financial security they need to fulfill their missions through the pursuit of excellence in everything we do, relentlessly focused on delivering superior investment results. We are industry pioneers who are passionate about constantly innovating to meet our clients’ needs today and anticipate their challenges tomorrow.

C:P1.2.text: Affiliated Managers Group (AMG) is a global asset management company that partners with outstanding alpha-generating independent firms.

C:P1.3.text: Independent investment firms have fundamental competitive advantages in generating differentiated returns.

C:P1.4.text: We invest in these firms through partnerships that magnify their success, as they bring their unique return streams to investors worldwide.

C:P1.5.text: We offer a unique approach to partnership.

C:P1.6.text: We provide the advantages of a long-term strategic partnership as we invest capital and resources in and alongside our partner firms while preserving their autonomy and independence. We adapt our solutions to our Affiliates’ unique strategic opportunities to create further success together.

C:P1.7.text: Committed to evolving and growing together.

C:P1.8.text: We offer powerful strategic capabilities centered around your firm’s distinct opportunities.

C:P1.9.text: We offer financial advisors and their clients access to investor-led independent managers with differentiated investment solutions.

C:P1.10.text: AMG’s global institutional distribution platform operates in key markets around the world, extending the reach of Affiliates’ business development efforts.

C:P1.11.text: Our Affiliates manage client assets across a diverse range of secular growth areas and are focused on creating value for their clients.

C:P1.12.text: Magnifying the success of independent firms around the world.

C:P2.2.text: Learn our history, and how we generate superior growth through partnerships with outstanding investment firms around the world.

C:P2.3.text: This website is designed for display in modern browsers. Your browser is not currently supported. Please use the latest version of Chrome, Opera, Firefox, Safari or Edge.

C:P2.4.text: AMG is a strategic partner to, and long-term investor in, leading independent investment firms globally.

C:P2.5.text: We provide the advantages of partnership to magnify our Affiliates’ success, while preserving their autonomy and independence. With AMG, Affiliates are able to expand their reach, diversify their business, and achieve further success.

C:P2.6.text: When Affiliates choose AMG as a partner, they are choosing independence. Not only do our partners value their autonomy, their clients also recognize that an independent firm’s entrepreneurial and investment-centric culture is instrumental to generating differentiated long-term returns.

C:P2.7.text: Having operated our distinct partnership model for 30 years, our entrepreneurial spirit, ownership mindset, and focus on excellence are deeply rooted.

C:P2.8.text: We generate long-term value by investing in a diverse array of high-quality independent partner-owned firms, through a proven partnership approach, and allocating resources across AMG’s unique opportunity set to the areas of highest growth and return.

C:P2.9.text: Diversified asset base and partnership structure enhance business stability and flexibility to invest for growth

C:P2.10.text: Our Affiliates maintain independence and autonomy as well as significant direct equity ownership in their individual firms.

C:P2.11.text: Through an AMG partnership, Affiliates’ interests stay aligned with their clients’ interests, and Affiliate management teams have the continued opportunity to participate directly in their firms’ long-term growth and success.

C:P2.12.text: We provide strategic and business development capabilities to our Affiliates to enhance their desired evolution toward new opportunities, and their next phase of success.
